paragraphs.text: Renting out a spare room can provide a useful extra income, but homeowners should think carefully before they advertise. The first step is to check whether their mortgage lender or landlord allows lodgers, as some agreements do not.

Most hosts ask potential lodgers for references from a previous landlord or employer. Meeting in person before agreeing is also wise, to see whether both people would be comfortable sharing a kitchen and bathroom.

A written agreement should state the rent, what it includes, such as heating and internet, and how much notice either side must give. It should also set out house rules, for example about guests or noise late at night.
In many countries, income from a lodger is tax-free up to a certain amount each year, but hosts should keep records of the payments they receive.
Many hosts say that clear expectations at the start prevent most problems later, especially about cleaning and the use of shared spaces.

items.quote: check whether their mortgage lender or landlord allows lodgers

explanation.en: “their mortgage lender or landlord allows lodgers” → landlord, letter C.
explanation.kk: «their mortgage lender or landlord allows lodgers» — несие беруші немесе үй иесі → landlord, яғни C әрпі.
explanation.ru: «their mortgage lender or landlord allows lodgers» → landlord, буква C.

items.quote: Most hosts ask potential lodgers for references

explanation.en: “Most hosts ask potential lodgers for references” → references, letter G. H (deposit) sounds logical but is not in the text.
explanation.kk: «Most hosts ask potential lodgers for references» → references, яғни G әрпі. H (deposit) қисынды, бірақ мәтінде кепіл ақы туралы ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: «Most hosts ask potential lodgers for references» → references, буква G. H (deposit) звучит логично, но в тексте о залоге ничего нет.

items.quote: how much notice either side must give

explanation.en: “how much notice either side must give” → notice, letter F. The “period” is the notice period.
explanation.kk: «how much notice either side must give» → notice, яғни F әрпі. Түйіндегі «period» — ескерту мерзімі.
explanation.ru: «how much notice either side must give» → notice, буква F. «Period» в пересказе — срок предупреждения.

items.quote: It should also set out house rules

explanation.en: “set out house rules” → rules, letter A. E (guests) is an example of a rule, not the word after “house”.
explanation.kk: «set out house rules» → rules, яғни A әрпі. E (guests) — ереженің мысалы, «house» сөзінен кейінгі сөз емес.
explanation.ru: «set out house rules» → rules, буква A. E (guests) — пример правила, а не само слово после «house».

items.quote: hosts should keep records of the payments they receive

explanation.en: “hosts should keep records of the payments they receive” → records, letter D. B (insurance) is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «hosts should keep records of the payments they receive» → records, яғни D әрпі. B (insurance) мәтінде аталмайды.
explanation.ru: «hosts should keep records of the payments they receive» → records, буква D. B (insurance) в тексте не упоминается.
